# CPU 40: the leaf's condition 'CPU 40 idle' names a CPU this host does not have (absent (the leaves' 'CPU 40 idle' names no CPU of this host); possible CPUs 0-31, smt active 0, smt control notsupported; CPU 8 thread siblings 8). # Quiet window: the campaign's cargo lane was held from the first build to the last run; pgrep -a 'cargo|rustc' showed no process before the runs and no process after them; cpu_snapshot(8) admitted the host before the runs (attempt 1) and admitted it after them. The mpstat tables before and after are in the log.

# Commands: builds first, on CPUs 16-31: HEAVY_MEMORY_MAX=8G heavy.sh cargo bench -p rholang --bench epathmap_ac_exact --no-run. Then each once, on CPU 8: systemd-run --user --scope -p MemoryMax=8G -p MemorySwapMax=0 taskset -c 8 cargo bench -p rholang --bench epathmap_ac_exact -- --sample-size 33 --save-baseline epoch-bf826516c --noplot.

# Statistics: one observation is one Criterion sample, mean_ns = time_ns / iters (one exact match per iteration, fixture cloning excluded); P: for sets and for maps, the 95% upper bound (97.5th percentile of a stratified bootstrap, 10000 replicates, seed 0x41315636) of the OLS slope of log(mean latency) on log(cardinality) over 16, 256, 4096 is at most 1.2, 33 samples per cell; the middle cell has zero OLS weight (log-equally spaced cardinalities).
# Software: Python 3.14.10, NumPy 2.5.4, SciPy 1.18.1.

# Validity: all 6 benchmarks hold 33 samples, reach Analyzing in the log and no panic occurs; red control (the same fit on a synthetic quadratic series, latency = cardinality squared): rejected, upper95 2.0000 (set) and 2.0000 (map); the window's samples rescaled to a quadratic series are rejected too, upper95 2.0002 (set) and 2.0003 (map).

# Citation: the 2026-08-16 means of byte_native_final from epathmap-ac-byte-native-2026-08-16.tsv (sha256:768824aadbe8c7120f24e6b2ab258a39b442e71ba60bf25aa2d5a87e80264e31) are the mean_2026_08_16_ns column; their end-point exponents are 0.8883 (set) and 0.9815 (map); that run took 82 samples per cell.
